name: Interactive Checklist
when_to_pick: A before-deploy or pre-trade checklist the reader actually ticks off. Each tick draws a check mark and advances a progress fill bar; ticking the last item unlocks a 'complete' state, so readers feel rewarded for finishing. Use as a closer for actionable how-to articles. Keep items short, imperative, and verifiable (something the reader can confirm 'yes/no'). For a single misconception-trap question with one right answer use quiz_single instead.
